simple.summary: שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל (Shᵉʼaltîyʼêl) means Shealtiel , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 3 17.

definitions.full: H7597. Shealtiel שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל proper name, masculine ( I have asked (him) of God ; on accusative compare (late) Psa 137:3 ); — first son of Jehoiachin and uncle of Zerubbabel according to 1Chr 3:17 (compare 3:18 ; 3:19 ); but Zerubbabel's father Hag 1:1 ; 2:23 ; Ezek 3:2 , 8 ; Neh 12:1 (attempts at explaining in Be Kit Benz). — Σαλαθιηλ . שַׁלְתִּיאֵל proper name, masculine (= שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל Thes Buhl); — father of Zerubbabel Hag 1:12 , 14 ; 2:2 ; Σαλαθιηλ .
definitions.rootNote: or שַׁלְתִּיאֵל ; from 7592 and 410 ; I have asked God ;
